# evroc_virtual_machine (Data Source)

Get information about an existing evroc virtual machine.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the virtual machine to look up.

### Optional

- `project` (String) Project this resource belongs to. Defaults to the provider project.
- `region` (String) Region where the VM is located.

### Read-Only

- `boot_disk` (String) Name of the boot disk.
- `data_disks` (List of String) List of FQIDs of additional data disks attached to the VM.
- `cloud_config_user_data` (String) Cloud-init user data script.
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the VM was created (RFC3339 format).
- `flavor` (String) VM flavor/size.
- `fqid` (String) Fully qualified resource ID (FQID).
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `ssh_keys` (List of String) List of SSH public keys.
- `status` (String) Current status of the virtual machine (e.g., Running, Stopped, Creating).
- `vm_id` (String) Unique identifier (UUID) of the virtual machine.
